cards.category: People, Places, and Things in The Lord of the Rings That Start With "R"

cards.category: People, Places, and Things in The Lord of the Rings That Start With "S"

cards.category: People, Places, and Things in The Lord of the Rings That Start With "L"

cards.category: People, Places, and Things in The Lord of the Rings That Start With "E"

cards.category: People, Places, and Things in The Lord of the Rings That Start With "D"
cards.fact: Unlike Saruman, Denethor was too strong to be corrupted by Sauron. He began secretly using a palantír to probe Sauron's strength, though he incorrectly insisted he was able to control it.

cards.category: Hobbits in The Lord of the Rings

cards.category: Elves in The Lord of the Rings
cards.fact: Celebrían is the daughter of Celeborn and Galadriel, wife of Elrond, and mother of Elrohir, Elladan and Arwen. She was referred to as "Lady of Rivendell". Her name means "silver queen" in Sindarin.

cards.category: Bad Guys in The Lord of the Rings
cards.fact: One thousand years into the Third Age, Sauron took a new form as the Necromancer, and founded the fortress of Dol Guldur in southern Mirkwood in TA 1050. This signaled the return of the Nine Nazgûl to Middle-earth.

cards.category: Good Guys in The Lord of the Rings
cards.fact: Although he lived among the Silvan Elves, Legolas was not one himself. His father Thranduil had originally come from Lindon; he and his son were actually Sindar, or "Grey Elves", called in the singular Sinda; "Sindarin" was their language.

cards.category: Scary Places in The Lord of the Rings
cards.fact: Travelling from the Old Forest to Bree, Frodo, Sam, Merry, and Pippin while travelling through the Barrow-downs were ensnared by a barrow-wight, probably in the same cairn which held the grave of the last prince of Cardolan.

cards.category: Most Famous Swords in The Lord of the Rings
cards.fact: Gúthwinë (Old English battle-friend) was a sword that belonged to Éomer. It was borne by him at the battle of Hornburg, and presumably at the battle of the Pelennor Fields and the battle before Morannon.

cards.category: Types of Weapons in The Lord of the Rings

cards.category: Places You'd Want to Go in The Lord of the Rings

cards.category: Food and Drinks in The Lord of the Rings

cards.category: Bodies of Water in The Lord of the Rings

cards.category: Halls in The Lord of the Rings

cards.category: Bridges and Walls in The Lord of the Rings

cards.category: Tribes and Clans in The Lord of the Rings

cards.category: People of Middle-Earth Who Lived in Forests

cards.category: Dragons in The Lord of the Rings

cards.category: Races in The Lord of the Rings
